senses.gloss:
m. (-ब्धिः)
The ocean.
E.
अब् substituted for अप् water; धि from धा to have, and कि aff.

m. (-फः)
Cuttle fish bone.
E.
अब्धि, and कफ phlegm; being considered as the froth of the sea.

m. du. (-जौ)
The two sons of SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga.
f. (-जा)
Wine.
E.
अब्धि, and ज born: the former are more usually termed the sons of AŚVINI, see आश्विनेय.

f. (-पा)
The earth.
E.
अब्धि, and द्वीप in the fem. form; an island surrounded by the ocean.

f. (-री)
A name of Dvārakā, the capital of KṚṢṆA, see द्वारका.
E.
अब्धि, and नगरी a city: the ocean-city.

m. (-कः)
The moon.
E.
अब्धि, नवनीत fresh butter, and क affix; produced by churning the ocean.

f. (-की)
A pearl oyster.
E.
अब्धि the ocean, and मण्डूकी a female frog.

m. (-नः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
अब्धि, and शयन sleeping; sleeping on the ocean at the periods of the destruction and renovation of the world, having the serpent ANANTA for his couch.

m. (-ग्निः)
Submarine fire.
E.
अब्धि, and अग्नि fire. see और्व्वस्.
